displayName: Allow Offline Maps Download Over Metered Connection
description: Allows the download and update of map data over metered connections. After the policy is applied, you can verify the settings in the user interface in System > Offline Maps.

options.displayName: Disabled. Force disable auto-update over metered connection.
options.description: Disabled. Force disable auto-update over metered connection.

options.displayName: Enabled. Force enable auto-update over metered connection.
options.description: Enabled. Force enable auto-update over metered connection.
